subject.title: fix(session-memory): forward hook config model to LLM slug generator

question: Should `hooks.internal.entries.session-memory.model` become a supported hook-level config key for LLM slug generation?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but it turns an open-ended passthrough key into behavior that affects provider/model routing during upgrades, which is a maintainer product/config contract decision.

options.title: Accept the hook model contract
options.body: Treat `session-memory.model` as intentional supported config and land this narrow forwarding fix once normal merge gates are satisfied.

options.title: Require more public guardrails
options.body: Ask for explicit docs or release-note wording before merge so upgrade behavior for the newly consumed key is clear.

options.title: Reject this config shape
options.body: Keep the PR paused or close it if maintainers prefer a different slug-model product surface instead of hook-level config.

recommendation.title: Accept the hook model contract
recommendation.body: Treat `session-memory.model` as intentional supported config and land this narrow forwarding fix once normal merge gates are satisfied.
